items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: The Schillinger method, given by a guy by the name of Rudy Schrann.

ctx.x: The Schillinger method, given by a guy by the name of Rudy Schrann. And Paul Start, of all people, was one of his cohorts.

Did you -- you didn't know Paul Start? Remember "Polly and Her Pals"? Cliff Start that used to write Polyano-Cars? His son -- now, he was working over at Columbia, good friend of mine, and he was one of the instructors there.
